branch_note: Two branches: `main` is the closed beta (OSCBWin7.0.51) and `live` is the shipped build (OSRELWin7.0.0, ddd9855b2ee5, 2026-08-10). `main` is pinned because it matches the nanoka version Chunk D seeded from — nanoka's `gi.latest` is 7.0.51 and its `gi.live` is 7.0, the same split. Two sources describing different patches would be worse than either alone.

layering.rule: NONE. Genshin's TextMap has no overwrite layer — see the note below.
layering.note: ZZZ published `TextMap_<LANG>TemplateTb.json` plus a `..OverwriteTemplateTb.json` layer, and fairy's toolkit merged them base-then-overwrite because beta content lived only in the overwrite layer. **This repository has no Overwrite file for any of its 16 languages** — the 31 entries in TextMap/ are one full map and one `_Medium` map per language (plus TH split in two). The merge is therefore not ported; the anchor assertion that made it trustworthy is.
